title: Venezuelan Chicken Empanadas
description: A delicious Venezuelan-inspired dish featuring chicken empanadas with vibrant flavors. Perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Prepare the empanada dough according to the package instructions.
In a pan, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Add the chicken breast to the pan and cook until browned.
Shred the chicken and set aside.
On a floured surface, roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of shredded cheese in the center of each dough circle.
Add a spoonful of the chicken mixture on top of the cheese.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-circle and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops with a little water and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
